critic_risk_flags: SEIRS adds waning-immunity dynamics that are unlikely to be identifiable or necessary in a short, single-season, high-peaked series; increased flexibility risks overfitting (spurious persistence/secondary structure) relative to simpler delayed_I SEIR options.

Observation map I+H is poorly aligned to a hospitalization-rate target without a clear surveillance justification; it increases flexibility and confounding between I and H, worsening identifiability in a short (31-week) single-season series and risking over-complexity without clear semantic benefit.
